judge_comment: FAIL ['C3']: Mitigants list includes several items that merely restate compliance (LTV below limit, DSCR above minimum, net debt/EBITDA under ceiling) rather than providing substantive mitigation; this violates the genuine mitigants requirement.

FAIL ['C2', 'C5']: The assessment claims the borrower has six years of trading history, exceeding the two‑year minimum, but the registry check (R10) disproves this, showing only 1.5 years since incorporation. This fact is not supported by the extracted terms and violates the case‑specific rule against citing six years of trading.
